[image: Solving Michigan's Housing Crisis illustration] Solving Michigan's Housing Crisis Housing is a homelessness problem, a shortage problem, and a market-power problem, and this plan answers all three. Lydia will pass a rapid rehousing program through HHS to get Michiganders off the streets fast, funded by capping the Pentagon budget rather than cutting help for people. She will fund zoning reform and homebuyer and builder credits to add housing supply, and close the corporate landlord loopholes and algorithmic rent-fixing driving costs up. Read More
